name: Стасиншина
base: Use case: stylized-concept, identity-preserve. Create ONE standalone waist-up visual novel game sprite of the adult woman teacher in INPUT1 photograph. Input1 identity/clothing reference ONLY: the woman seated at bottom-right, with short dark brown side-parted hair, rounded face, blue-gray eyes, natural middle-aged facial features, small earrings, patterned cream/blush pink/black long-sleeve blouse with draped neckline. Preserve her recognizable facial proportions, age, build, hairstyle and blouse pattern/colors. Input2 teacher Popov game sprite is ART STYLE reference ONLY, do not copy his face/body/clothing. Adapt original Popov base prompt: calm waist-up game portrait from reference photo, slight 3/4, composed strict face, illustrated visual novel style. Polished 2D illustrated anime-adjacent visual novel portrait, crisp contour lines, restrained cel shading, natural adult proportions, same level of realism and shading as Popov. Woman standing upright, upper body turned very slightly 3/4, looking toward player, neutral composed mildly strict teaching expression, eyebrows relaxed, lips closed, arms down relaxed. Framing: full head, hair, shoulders and torso down to waist, headroom, shoulders and elbows comfortably inside canvas. Genuine transparent background, isolated character only, no desk, chair, classroom, board, papers, other people, text, symbols, logos or watermark. Natural hands if visible, do not exaggerate or beautify into a young woman. Opaque character with clean alpha edges. Portrait aspect ratio 2:3.
